tasks.label: Build
args: if (-not (Get-Command gcc -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue)) { Write-Error 'gcc was not found in PATH.'; exit 1 }; $sourceRoot = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'source'; $project = Join-Path $sourceRoot $env:PROJECT_FOLDER; if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $project -PathType Container)) { throw "Project folder not found: $project" }; $build = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'build'; $sources = Get-ChildItem -LiteralPath $project -Filter '*.c' -File -Recurse; if (-not $sources) { throw "No .c source files found in $project" }; New-Item -ItemType Directory -Force -Path $build | Out-Null; $output = Join-Path $build ((Split-Path $project -Leaf) + '.exe'); $sourcePaths = @($sources | ForEach-Object { $_.FullName }); & gcc -Wall -Wextra -std=c11 $sourcePaths -o $output; if ($LASTEXITCODE -ne 0) { exit $LASTEXITCODE }

tasks.label: Archive
args: $project = Join-Path (Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'source') $env:PROJECT_FOLDER; $build = Join-Path '${workspaceFolder}' 'build'; $exe = Join-Path $build ((Split-Path $project -Leaf) + '.exe'); if (-not (Test-Path -LiteralPath $exe -PathType Leaf)) { throw "Executable not found: $exe. Run Build first." }; Compress-Archive -LiteralPath $exe -DestinationPath (Join-Path $build ((Split-Path $project -Leaf) + '.zip')) -Force
